conviction_note: The Q3 trading statement's one open line is whether the CRO margin guide holds. H1 CRO EBIT was DKK 1.5m (1% margin), and the 10-15% full-year guide needs roughly an 18-26% margin in H2, against about 4% in H2 2025. That makes a cut plausible, so the finding is -0.8. The scaled number is smaller, (2x0.47-1)x5.5 = -0.33, because this stock rose on each of its last three CRO guidance cuts (+4.3%, +1.9%, +1.0%) and the CRO is only about a tenth of its value. The big Q3 item, the USD 50m AbbVie milestone, is already public.

findings.finding: Gubra's 2026 CRO EBIT-margin guide of 10-15% needs roughly an 18-26% margin in H2 to hold. H1 CRO EBIT was DKK 1.5m (1%) on DKK 96.4m external revenue, and H2 2025 ran at about 4% (FY2025 CRO about 15% adjusted on DKK 193m, less H1 2025 EBIT of DKK 24.4m). So a second CRO margin cut in the Q3 trading statement, or as inside information the evening before, is more likely than not.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The last three CRO guidance cuts were followed by gains, not losses. The 2025-08-20 CRO warning was followed by +4.3% the next day; the 2025-11-06 evening CRO warning by +1.9% on 2025-11-07; the 2026-05-06 Q1 cut of both growth and margin by +1.0% (Yahoo GUBRA.CO daily closes). The stock trades on the pipeline, not the CRO.
findings.original_quote: CRO EBIT-margin H1 2026: 1% ... EBIT 1.5 ... 'Outlook 2026 (unchanged) ... CRO External revenue 0-10% growth ... EBIT-margin 10-15%'. Inderes H1 note (da site, English text): 'profitability returned to positive territory with EBIT of DKK 1.5 million, corresponding to a margin of 1%, affected by DKK 2 million in one-off costs'.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The H1 margin is public, and Inderes calls the Q3 statement 'the next test' of the margin path. But management reiterated 10-15% in August on a 'sound order book', and Inderes still values the CRO on the guide-midpoint EBIT of ~DKK 25.6m. If the market had priced a cut, Inderes's valuation would sit below the midpoint, and the 2026-10-27 strategy release would not have restated a 10% CRO growth target without touching 2026. The short register at 1.34% is not building in a way that signals informed selling. The finding is small because the CRO is about a tenth of value (20.3x x DKK 25.6m, roughly DKK 0.5bn, per Inderes) and because the stock shrugged off the last three CRO cuts.

Inderes (2026-10-28) separately flags the margin as the open question and says the 2030 CRO target 'does not address margins' (https://www.inderes.dk/en/analyst-comments/gubra-2030-strategy-puts-numbers-on-the-ambition-while-near-term-value-drivers-are-unchanged).

baseline_tension: The finding is negative while the lean is mildly positive (+0.34, from a 1.34% short). It goes against the 20-day run-up of +9.4% and agrees with the 60-day of -21%. The stock's habit of rising on CRO cuts keeps p_up near 50, so the scaled number (-0.33) is well under half the -0.8 finding.
language_note: Gubra publishes all releases in English only on Nasdaq Copenhagen, so the filings carried nothing in Danish that the English ones did not.

The one Danish-language item that mattered was Inderes/HC Andersen Capital's Danish Q3 event page. It confirms the 6 November date ('Gubra ventes at offentliggøre sin handelsopdatering for tredje kvartal af 2026 den 6. november 2026') and repeats the milestone booking in Q3 ('ventes indtægtsført i Q3'). Inderes's English note of 2026-10-28 carries the same date, so this is confirmation, not new information.
No independent Danish press (Børsen, MedWatch) or retail-forum item on the Q3 or the CRO turned up; the local half added nothing the English sources did not already carry.
lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' (guidance changes median 9.0% vs 2.3%): a CRO guide cut is likely, so abs_move_pct went from 4.5 to 5.5. It stays below 9 because this name's CRO changes have moved it 1-4% and the CRO is about a tenth of value.

'Reaction history vetoes the direction, not the size': the stock rose after each of its last three CRO cuts, so p_up moved from 46 to 47. The finding stays at -0.8; it was already sized net of the rest of the company.
'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': confirmed the AbbVie milestone stays out of findings (it was already in already_public).
